name: computer-use
description: How to operate a computer — the capabilities an agent needs to reach past its own text output and act on a real machine. Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview, and out-of-band notifications that reach the user when the terminal cannot.

Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview, and out-of-band notifications that reach the user when the terminal cannot.

interface.shortDescription: Browser control with graceful degradation, rich document artifacts, and notifications that reach the user
interface.longDescription: Capabilities for acting on a real machine rather than only describing what to do. graceful-browser picks the browser automation stack that is genuinely available in the current session and degrades transparently when a higher-priority one is not; a Chrome DevTools MCP server ships with the plugin so there is something to degrade to. mdx-artifact turns content into a componentized MDX document and serves a local preview for a human to read. notify-user decides whether a moment is worth interrupting someone for and sends it over a configured channel, macOS Notification Center today, and the Claude end can wire it to the end of a turn automatically. install-computer-use collects everything that lives outside the plugin directory — a global renderer, a warmed npm cache, and the one consent notifications-that-fire-on-their-own require — into a single step the user asks for.
